title: Cooperative register: Halberd Mills, filing summary
text: Halberd Mills Cooperative was incorporated in the spring of 1997 and remains registered at its original address in Cawden Vale. Principal activity: manufacture of wool blankets and throws. The cooperative's return for the current year reports about a hundred and fifty weavers on its rolls. Awards recorded in members' filings include the Fenmoor design award.
notes: Set B. Registry extract; clipped official register voice. Its membership figure is explicitly for the current year, so it conflicts with the other two rather than describing an earlier period.
